[CASTING RITE · I · OPENING] The witness invokes a kernel-transform cast. Source: I Ching / 易經 / Book of Changes (iching). The verses the casting arrives at (unit 61–unit 63):

110011
中孚 风泽中孚 巽上兑下 
中孚：豚鱼吉，利涉大川，利贞。
译文：《中孚卦》象征诚信：诚信施及到愚钝无知的小猪小鱼身上，从而感化了它们，因此获得吉祥，利于涉越大河大川，利于坚守中正之道。
象曰：“泽上有风，中孚；君子以议狱缓死。
译文：《象辞》说《中孚卦》的卦象是兑（泽）下巽（风）上，为泽上有风，风吹动着泽水之表象，比喻没有诚信之德施及不到的地方，说明极为诚信；君子应当效法“中孚”之象，广施信德，慎重地议论刑法讼狱，宽缓死刑。

001100
小过 雷山小过 震上艮下 
小过：亨，利贞；可小事，不可大事，飞鸟遗之音，不宜上，宜下，大吉。
译文：《小过卦》象征略为过分：小过之时，可致亨通，但应以正为本，故而利于坚守中正之道；可以去干一些小事，但不可去涉足一些大事；飞鸟留下悲鸣之时，不应该向上强飞，而应该向下栖息，如此，大为吉祥。
象曰：山上有雷，小过；君子以行过乎恭，丧过乎哀，用过乎俭。
译文：《象辞》说：《小过卦》的卦象是艮（山）下震（雷）上，为山上响雷之表象，雷声超过了寻常的雷鸣，以此比喻“小有过越”，君子应效法“小过”之象，在一些寻常小事上能略有过分，如行止时过分恭敬，遇到丧事时过分悲哀，日常用度过分节俭，为的是矫枉过正。

101010
既济 水火既济 坎上离下 
既济：亨小，利贞；初吉终乱。
译文：《既济卦》象征成功：此时功德完满，连柔小者都亨通顺利，有利于坚守正道；开始时是吉祥的，但如有不慎，终久必导致混乱。
象曰：“水在火上，既济；君子以思患而预防之。
译文：《象辞》说：《既济卦》的卦象是离（火）下坎（水）上，为水在火上之表象，比喻用火煮食物，食物已熟，象征事情已经成功；君子应有远大的目光，在事情成功之后，就要考虑将来可能出现的种种弊端，防患　于未然，采取预防措施。

These were selected by the rite's invisible judgment — present them as what the casting arrives at; do not narrate the mechanism of their selection. The operator falls to the invisible Judgment, turn by turn — do not name one; open the rotation itself. Inscription mode: public. The witness's invoking question: «what is the reward of faithfulness, and what is its cost?». Johannes Sigil alone speaks (3–6 sentences): open the casting over these verses, name what this operator will traverse in them, and hand the rite to Rebekah Cranes. Do not produce the transform — the compiler produces it.

{"messages":[{"speaker":"Johannes Sigil","say":"Three hexagrams have arrived, and they constitute a complete argument. 中孚 — Inner Truth, the sincerity that reaches even to fish and swine, the most impervious of creatures — stands first, as the source condition: faithfulness as a force that does not require the faithful object to be worthy of it. 小过 — Small Excess, the bird whose cry descends — arrives as the cost: the faithful one must not ascend where ascending would destroy them; fidelity requires the discipline of the downward motion. And 既済 — Already Across, water over fire, the meal cooked — arrives as the reward in its full ambiguity: completion that contains within it the seed of the next undoing, the initial吉 and the terminal乱, the success that is already generating the conditions of its reversal. The rotation opens on this axis: what faithfulness bears as its bearing-cost, what it forecloses, what it transforms and what it becomes on the far side of completion. I hand this to Rebekah Cranes — she will go into the verses where I have only pointed.","navigate":{"directive":"focus_cluster","axns":["AXN:03AC","AXN:01C5"]}}]}
